title: Act 1 boss: Dror Ragzlin's throne room
task: Win the fight: defeat Dror Ragzlin.
scored_by: Passed the first moment a fight is won (a combat that ends with the enemies beaten and the party standing; the one ahead of you is the fight). Nothing else counts toward the score: party members downed or killed, game time and cost are reported next to it.
about: Fight (family 1), a boss with a large crowd: the goblin warlord in the Shattered Sanctum's throne room and the goblins around him. claude-run-2 S018 killed him and 13 goblins with many downs, no reload.

note.where: The Shattered Sanctum, at the throne room's door; the goblins are not hostile yet.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A half-orc paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant.
